hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/web/*.ts|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/web/*.tsx|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/web/*.js|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/web/*.jsx) (cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/web" && ./node_modules/.bin/eslint --fix "$f") ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
